bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features and fixes enhance user experience across Dev, Beta, and Canary Channels.
Azure Storage Discovery Launched - New service provides enterprise-wide visibility into data management in Azure.
Microsoft's Cybersecurity Insights - Over half of cyberattacks driven by financial gain, highlighting urgent need for robust defenses.
AI Integration in Windows 11 - New Copilot features enhance productivity and security for users.
Microsoft Sentinel Recognized - Named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM, enhancing security operations.
ExCyTIn-Bench Tool Launched - New benchmarking tool evaluates AI performance in cybersecurity investigations.
Building a Security Culture - Microsoft emphasizes the importance of a proactive security culture among employees.
